title: Hellinger Decision Trees for Density Ratio Estimation: Finite-Sample Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2611.25936v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Density ratios play a central role in two-sample comparison, distribution-shift adaptation, and generative-model evaluation. However, estimating a density ratio through separate estimation of the underlying densities can be unnecessarily challenging. In this paper, we develop a direct approach to the log density ratio estimation by minimizing a balanced Hellinger risk over additive ensembles of axis-aligned decision trees, trained using Newton boosting. We establish finite-sample guarantees for the estimator produced by the algorithm and derive an explicit convergence rate. Under suitable tail and H\"{o}lder smoothness conditions, together with an additional assumption on the progress made at each boosting iteration, our rate matches, up to logarithmic factors, the classical minimax-optimal $ \mathscr{L}^{2} $ rate for function estimation. translated_title: 用于密度比估计的Hellinger决策树：有限样本保证
translated_abstract: 密度比在双样本比较、分布偏移适应以及生成模型评估中起着核心作用。然而，通过对底层密度分别进行估计来估计密度比可能是不必要的困难。在本文中，我们开发了一种直接估计对数密度比的方法，即在轴对齐决策树的加性集成上最小化平衡的Hellinger风险，并使用牛顿提升进行训练。我们为该算法产生的估计器建立了有限样本保证，并推导出了显式的收敛速率。在适当的尾部条件和Hölder光滑性条件下，再加上关于每次提升迭代所取得进展的额外假设，我们的速率在忽略对数因子的情况下与函数估计的经典极小极大最优 $\mathscr{L}^{2}$ 速率相匹配。一个关键的技术贡献是利用特殊的指数结构进行的优化分析。
tldr: 提出了一种通过牛顿提升在轴对齐决策树集成上最小化平衡Hellinger风险来直接估计对数密度比的方法，并建立了有限样本保证，其收敛速率在对数因子范围内达到极小极大最优的L²速率。
en_tdlr: Proposes a direct log density ratio estimation method via additive ensembles of axis-aligned decision trees trained with Newton boosting to minimize a balanced Hellinger risk, establishing finite-sample guarantees with convergence rates matching the minimax-optimal L² rate up to logarithmic factors.
